payload.name: Failure mode in I-1795493412-ledger-temp-worktree-cleanup/P-1795493432-CLA-CF5.2/E-1795505480-CLA-CF5.2/_
payload.description: Reproduced failure across 4 executions with identical context.
payload.action: Review Loop iteration 1 finding detected: FIND-R2-001-01
symptoms: A run whose process group is killed during `git worktree add` leaves a detached ledger worktree that git marks `locked initializing`; the sweep skips every locked worktree and `git worktree prune` never prunes one, so the registration and its temp directory stay forever (reproduced with a real kill). Sweep such a worktree when its owner lock can be claimed, using `git worktree remove --force --force`, and add a test.
